purpose: Which assetPlan alias slugs (world/sources/catalogue/asset-aliases.json) a place record may carry, by the record's culture and secondaryCultures (decision 0100 decision 7: a kit the place's culture does not use is a record defect). Each row lists the inventory family cultures it admits and the slugs those families resolve to; test_record_services.py holds the two in step and checks every record.

argonian.source: docs/world/97-placement-principles.md:773-775 (Part F argonian-stilt, argonian-mud, argonian-root kit sets; each bans stone, so no imperial-stone-timber); common layer: inventory families tagged neutral (world/sources/placement/settlement-asset-inventory.json) and xanmeer-ancient, the dead layer present province-wide as ruin (docs/world/97-placement-principles.md:776, Part F argonian-stone 'xanmeer sites province-wide'); foreign-other watercraft because Part F bans keeled hulls only 'as native craft' (docs/world/97-placement-principles.md:773), not as visiting boats

imperial.source: docs/world/97-placement-principles.md:777 (Part F imperial: ashlar, tile, timber frame; the keep set; never stilts or reed); common layer: inventory families tagged neutral (world/sources/placement/settlement-asset-inventory.json) and xanmeer-ancient, the dead layer present province-wide as ruin (docs/world/97-placement-principles.md:776, Part F argonian-stone 'xanmeer sites province-wide'); foreign-other watercraft because Part F bans keeled hulls only 'as native craft' (docs/world/97-placement-principles.md:773), not as visiting boats

dunmer.source: docs/world/97-placement-principles.md:778 (Part F dunmer-hlaalu: the Hlaalu domestic set); foreign-other for arch.foreign.dunmer-velothi (asset-aliases.json dunmer-telvanni), the inventory's Dunmer border family; common layer: inventory families tagged neutral (world/sources/placement/settlement-asset-inventory.json) and xanmeer-ancient, the dead layer present province-wide as ruin (docs/world/97-placement-principles.md:776, Part F argonian-stone 'xanmeer sites province-wide'); foreign-other watercraft because Part F bans keeled hulls only 'as native craft' (docs/world/97-placement-principles.md:773), not as visiting boats

mixed.source: a 'mixed' record is Imperial and Argonian together: the union of the argonian (docs/world/97-placement-principles.md:773-775) and imperial (docs/world/97-placement-principles.md:777) rows; common layer: inventory families tagged neutral (world/sources/placement/settlement-asset-inventory.json) and xanmeer-ancient, the dead layer present province-wide as ruin (docs/world/97-placement-principles.md:776, Part F argonian-stone 'xanmeer sites province-wide'); foreign-other watercraft because Part F bans keeled hulls only 'as native craft' (docs/world/97-placement-principles.md:773), not as visiting boats
